title: Liam Boyd
text:
About Me
I’m a Data Analyst specializing in the energy sector, where I apply quantitative methods to complex market challenges. My academic background combines finance and data science, which I’ve applied professionally across both wholesale and retail energy markets. At Orennia, I analyze generation assets and grid fundamentals, while my previous work at 8760 focused on customer-level data, examining electricity and gas billing patterns to inform retail strategy.
I work primarily in R, Python, SQL, and Excel to build analytical workflows that deliver actionable insights. Over the longer term, I’m particularly interested in power trading and the structure of financial energy markets.
Outside of work, I’m an avid car enthusiast and traveler, often planning international trips around music festivals and exploring new cities.
